title: Smoking Violation
description: Use this service request to report smoking occurring at FOOD and NON-FOOD establishments, i.e., at Bingo and Billiard Halls, Bars, Convenience Stores in any City of Dallas owned or operated facility or office building. The estimated response time for this service request is 7 business days.

observedQuestions.label: Is the smoking occurring at a business or restaurant?
What type of establishment is this?
What is the name of the establishment?
What is the name of the person(s) smoking, if known?
Where on the premises is the smoking taking place?
What date/time did the smoking violation occur?

observedInstructions: Across Business and Restaurant combined with all nine establishment types, no answer-dependent questions appeared except the required description when establishment type is Other. Restaurant + Bar showed a New Service Type Suggestion recommending Smoking Violation itself. All additional optional fields remained the same across combinations.
detailsForm.contactStepObserved: Contact step showed optional consent; First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone Number, Address, City, State, Zipcode were disabled by default.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about smoking at a Dallas food or nonfood establishment.
actions.why: For smoking at a food or nonfood establishment, including restaurants, bars, bingo or billiard halls, convenience stores, retail stores, workplaces, office buildings, or City-operated buildings. The 311 request form asks for establishment type and name, location on the premises, and date and time.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Smoking Violation"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Smoking Violation"
